Daniel.style: Read this as a warm, unhurried financial advisor speaking on a phone call:

Emma.style: Read this as a friendly, confident professional in their forties on a phone call:

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Hi Emma, it's Daniel from Atrium. Thanks for making time today. Is this still a good moment to talk?

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Yes, perfect. I have about twenty minutes before my next meeting.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Great. I have the form you filled in last week in front of me. You said you'd like to retire by fifty-five and keep growing what you've saved. Is that still the plan?

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Mostly, but it's changed a bit. We talked it over at home, and I'd like to retire at fifty-two now. So that's twelve years from now, not fifteen.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Twelve years. That's helpful to know, thank you. It changes how long the money has to grow.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Right. And the other change is the monthly amount. I put fifteen hundred dollars a month on the form, but I got a raise in September, so I can put in two thousand dollars a month.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Two thousand a month. When would you like that to start?

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: From next month, once the new salary comes through.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Understood. And the lump sum on the form was one hundred and fifty thousand dollars. Is that the amount you'd start with?

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: It's a little more now. With my bonus it's about one hundred and seventy-five thousand dollars.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Thank you. And that's all saved from your salary, as the form says?

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Yes, all of it is from work. Nothing else.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: That's clear. Can I ask how you'd feel if the value fell for a year or two along the way? Every investment carries risk, and markets go down as well as up.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: I'd be uncomfortable, but I wouldn't sell. I know it's a long game.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: That's a sensible way to see it. With twelve years, a balanced growth mix could suit you, but I'd like to send you a written proposal first, with the fees and the risks laid out, so you can take your time.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: That would be great. Could you also show what happens if I retire a year or two later than planned?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Of course, I'll show both. I'll also update your profile with the new timeline, the monthly amount and the starting sum, and you can check them before anything is set up.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Thank you, Emma. You'll have the proposal by Friday. Speak soon.
